edge_explainer.market_believes: Maravai is a recovered, inflecting life-sciences supplier: +40% revenue growth, a raised guide, restructuring paying off — the post-COVID hangover is over.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The recovery is real but smaller than the print: a ~15%-growing durable base plus one big one-time Pfizer COVID order, with the EBITDA jump mostly cost cuts. The company's own full-year guide says the rest of the year steps down sharply from Q1.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None on the long — that's the finding. The market prices the durable-inflection outcome at ~51%; the verified order mix supports ~25%.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It IS priced in — consensus moved to the raised guide and the stock trades above the highest analyst target. That's why the verdict is no-position, not buy.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The Aug-10 print: the guide implies visible sequential decline; watch whether the ex-COVID base accelerates above 15% and Cygnus holds.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Wrong if Aug-10 shows ex-COVID base accel >~18% + RUO->GMP conversions + Cygnus reaccel sustaining >7x forward sales into $45-55M FY27 EBITDA — durability structural, market's 51% justified — or if GTCR launches a take-private above intrinsic.
edge_explainer.edge_type: no-edge verdict; conditional dislocation-buy on the flip tripwires (buy durability at the SOTP floor, don't pay 51% odds for it)
